visualCharacteristics: Black footer (#000), white text, padding 45px 0 45px; content in the 1170px container. Top row (desktop): logo 180px wide (x 80) in a 25% column, then the link columns (16.67% each, 16px myriad-pro weight 400, white, 10px between links), then "Follow Us" (16px weight 300) with three 20px white social icons in a row (Facebook, X, LinkedIn), 15px apart. Bottom row 50px below: legal links (14px weight 400 white) separated by tall "|" separators (17px weight 300, padding 0 5px 0 10px), on the left (66.67%); copyright right-aligned (14px weight 300) on the right (33.33%). Mobile: logo, then the link columns in a row of 3 (33% each), then Follow Us + icons, then the legal links (wrapping) and the copyright (left-aligned). Links: no underline, underline on hover. Social icons: SVG icons in /icons (facebook, x, linkedin), picked from the link host. Fonts: body 'myriad-pro' (fallback Arial) 18px weight 300 line-height 1.45; headings 'tungstenw05-medium' (fallback Oswald, then sans-serif) weight 500. The Infosys font files are commercial and must NOT be copied into this public repo: use font-family stacks 'myriad-pro, arial, sans-serif' and 'tungstenw05-medium, oswald, sans-serif' through CSS custom properties (--infosys-body-font, --infosys-heading-font) defined on the block (or body.infosys), and load Oswald from Google Fonts as the heading fallback only if the project already loads web fonts that way; otherwise rely on the stack. Content width: centred 1170px container from 1200px wide (970px from 992px, 750px from 768px), 15px side padding, full width below 768px.
contentPattern: Container block. Block fields: logo (reference), logoAlt (text), logoLink (aem-content), socialTitle (text), socialLinks (richtext list of links), legalLinks (richtext list of links), copyright (text). Child items "infosys-footer-column" with a field links (richtext: a list of links), one per link column. The project footer block (blocks/footer/footer.js) loads the footer page as a fragment; when that fragment holds an infosys-footer block it hands over to it.
usage: Only on the Infosys footer page (e.g. /infosys-poc/footer); blocks/footer hands over to it.
reuseGuidance: Not for use in page content; scoped to the Infosys footer fragment.
